title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above at an angle. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square. A raised gold disc labelled Goal sits on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows a blue arrow from the token pointing along a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the gold Goal square on the top-right. The shortest route is 4 moves.
game.hint: Steps to goal = rows apart + columns apart. Every move that lowers it by 1 is on a shortest route.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the starting camera (toward the Goal row); a move off the board does nothing and is not counted.
The start and goal never change, and the board has no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
